name: NETGEAR ProSAFE GS105 5-Port Gigabit Ethernet Unmanaged Desktop Switch
description: Selling an authentic NETGEAR ProSAFE GS105 5-Port Gigabit Ethernet Unmanaged Desktop Switch. Verified precisely by the official factory top stamp displaying Model: GS105 from the enterprise ProSAFE series. Housed in an iconic, rugged industrial steel enclosure built like a tank, this fanless network hub delivers 100% silent operation. It features 5 non-blocking 10/100/1000 Mbps auto-sensing ports to instantly expand your wired home routing, home lab, or gaming setup with wire-speed data transfer. Supports 802.1p QoS traffic prioritization and Energy Efficient Ethernet (IEEE 802.3az) automatically. The switch is in excellent cosmetic and perfect operational condition. Coming from a pet-friendly home environment with a cat; the unit has been meticulously deep-vacuumed, air-blown, and thoroughly disinfected with isopropyl alcohol pads prior to listing.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled business-grade hardware operating immediately with zero-configuration plug-and-play setup. Since this is an unpadded hard steel structural network component, it does NOT come with an additional fabric or cloth retail storage cover bag. Please bring your own small shopping bag or pouch for local transport during pickup. Rest assured that although the device comes from a cat-friendly home, it has been deeply disinfected, though faint unseen pet traces may remain. Price boundaries are kept highly flat and smooth as requested!
